title: A member looks from a typed place, and home stays the default

criteria.text: The place control on Explore takes a typed town, county or market with suggestions; shows the home town by default
criteria.note: The place control is still `AreaPicker`: a metro list (open first, waiting ordered by the cached count since #1031) and a type-to-search over neighbourhoods in the current metro; no typed town, county or market, no suggestions over the place tree [V src/components/explore/AreaPicker.tsx]. #1038 (2026-10-24, F103.4) changed its words from 'metro' to 'area' and nothing else [V PR body]. `explore_vantage` (#932) starts the rings from the member's home town but names it 'you' and offers no control [V]. Open #698, deferred.

criteria.text: Choosing a place sets the vantage for the session and is taken as the area type it is; the rings rebuild there
criteria.note: No vantage model in the repo; today `?metro=`, `?area=` and a metro cookie (#479), and `member.default_metro.set` still remembers the last area (#1038 kept it) [V]. The rings rebuild only from the home town or the market's principal city, never from a chosen place [V]. Open #698.

criteria.text: The vantage is session-only: never written to the member, never logged, never from IP or GPS; a shared link reopens it
criteria.note: Not built; the metro is a cookie and `default_metro_id` on the member, and the area pick is saved as the member's default (#479) [V]. `?reach=` already travels in the link (#932). A guard is in #698's checklist. Open #698.

criteria.text: A vantage in a waiting market shows its cached waiting count and the tell-me control, and no Pages; another open market shows in full
criteria.note: The waiting count and tell-me panel exist for a metro (`MetroNotCoveredPanel`, F076) and the cached count now loads (#1031 fixed #686 on 2026-10-24), but no vantage reaches them: the panel opens only from the picker [V]. Open #699, deferred.

criteria.text: A visitor with no location is prompted to enter a location or choose a market, with an arrow to the market selector; nothing is picked
criteria.note: Not built: `resolveFeedMetro` still falls back to `DEFAULT_METRO_SLUG` (Sacramento) for a visitor, and a signed-out visitor's rings start from the market's principal city (#932) [V src/lib/feed/feed-metro.ts line 116]. Ruled 2026-10-12 (F105 Rulings); #699 records on 2026-10-25 that the ruling answers #588's question by newer-wins, so what is left for the PM is the prompt's words. Open #699 (deferred), #588 (needs-pm).
